sn22.90:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2
sn22.90:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Channo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallaṇā vuṭṭhito avāpuranam ādāya vihārena vihāram upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn22.90:1.3: Ovadantu mam āyasmanto therā anusāsantu mam āyasmantā therā karontu me āyasmanto therā dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyan ti || || 3
sn22.90:2.1: Evaṃ vutte therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Channam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.90:3.1: Atha kho āyasmato Channassa etad ahosi || ||
sn22.90:3.2: Mayham pi kho etam evaṃ hoti || ||
sn22.90:3.11: Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā sabbe dhammā anattā ti || || 5
sn22.90:3.12: Atha ca pana me sabbasaṅkhārasamathe sabbūpadhipaṭinissagge taṇhakkhaye virāge nirodhe nibbāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati
sn22.90:3.16: na kho panetaṃ dhammam passato hoti || ||
sn22.90:3.17: Ko nu kho me tathā dhammaṃ deseyya yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyan ti || || 6
sn22.90:4.1: Atha kho āyasmato Channassa etad ahosi || ||
sn22.90:4.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ || pahoti ca me āyasmā Ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyaṃ || ||
sn22.90:4.3: Atthi ca me āyasmante Ānande tāvatikā visaṭṭhi yaṃ
sn22.90:4.5: Atha kho āyasmā Channo senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Kosambi-Ghositārāmo yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi || pa || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Channo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn22.90:5.1: Ekam idāham āvuso Ānanda samayam Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharāmi Isipatane Migadāye || ||
sn22.90:5.2: Atha khvāham āvuso sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito avāpūraṇam ādāya vihārena vihāram
sn22.90:5.4: Ovadantu mam āyasmanto therā dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyan ti || || 9
sn22.90:5.5: Evaṃ vutte mam āvuso therā bhikkhū etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.90:5.13: Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā sabbe dhammā anattā ti || || 10
sn22.90:6.2: Mayham pi kho etam evam hoti
sn22.90:6.8: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā sabbe dhammā anattā ti || || 11
sn22.90:6.9: Atha ca pana me sabbasaṅkhārasamathe sabbūpadhipaṭinissagge taṇhakkhaye virāge nirodhe nibbāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati
sn22.90:6.12: atha ko carahi me attā ti ||
sn22.90:6.13: na kho panetaṃ dhammam passato hoti || ||
sn22.90:6.14: Ko nu kho me tathā dhammaṃ deseyya yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyan ti || || 12
sn22.90:7.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānanda Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti ca me āyasmā Ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ dhammam passeyyaṃ || ||
sn22.90:7.3: Atthi ca me āyasmante Ānande tāvatikā visaṭṭhi yaṃ
sn22.90:7.7: karotu me āyasmā Ānando dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāham dhammam passeyyan ti || || 14
sn22.90:8.1: Ettakena pi mayam āyasmato Channassa attamanā || api nāma tam āyasmā Channo āvi akāsi khilam pabhindi ||
sn22.90:8.4: Atha kho āyasmato Channassa tāvatakeneva uḷāram pītipāmujjam uppajji || ||
sn22.90:9.1: Sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Channa Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā ca paṭiggahitaṃ Kaccānagottam bhikkhum ovadantassa || ||
sn22.90:9.2: Dvayanissito khvāyaṃ Kaccāna loko yebhuyyena atthi tañceva natthi tañ ca || ||
sn22.90:9.3: Lokasamudayaṃ kho Kaccāna yathābhūtam sammappaññāya passato yā loke natthitā sā na hoti ||
sn22.90:9.4: loka nirodhaṃ kho Kaccāna yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti || ||
sn22.90:9.6: tañcāyam upāyupādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā na upeti na upādiyati || nādhiṭṭhāti Attā me ti || ||
sn22.90:9.7: Dukkham eva uppajjamānam uppajjati dukkhaṃ niruddhamānaṃ nirujjhatīti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati
sn22.90:9.10: Sabbam atthīti kho Kaccāna ayam eko anto ||
sn22.90:9.12: Ete te Kaccāna ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn22.90:9.15: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn22.90:9.17: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 18
sn22.90:10.1: Evam etam āvuso Ānanda hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacāriyo anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā ||
sn22.90:10.2: idaṃ ca pana me āyasmato Ānandassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā dhammo abhisameto ti || || 1
